title: RNA-Seq of Gingival Fibroblasts Grown on Collagen Membranes and Hyaluronic Acid
authors: Panahipour L, Huang X, Gruber R. J Funct Biomater. 2026 Jan 23;17(2):57. doi: 10.3390/jfb17020057. * collafleece®
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “These findings demonstrate that collagen membranes can influence the transcriptome of gingival fibroblasts and suggest that collagen fleece has a stronger effect on extracellular matrix formation than mucoderm®. Furthermore, HA coating does not consistent ly alter fibroblast responses” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
